question: Under which external-receipt, Product-margin, service-reserve, W-cycle and U-horizon conditions can this network fund repeated research periods without exhausting cash, token inventory, service capacity or contractual rights?
inclusions: Stock-flow accounting for C, W and U
Product-supported, sponsor-supported and hybrid funding regimes
Bayesian value of sample information for experiment choice
Finite burn and candidate recycled-W supply paths
No-revenue, delayed-revenue, high-redemption and cost-overrun stress paths
exclusions: Guaranteed W market price or return
Treating secondary W trading as Product treasury revenue
Automatic commercial success from accepted research
Retrospective changes to existing U contracts
Live token issuance or financial commitments

selection_criteria: Separate accounting identities from causal assumptions
Show each external C source and restricted liability
Compare a no-sale stress path with a measured-demand path
source_policy.freshness_rule: Refresh Product and market observations at each decision cut; retain dated source versions.
source_policy.conflict_handling: Keep competing demand and cost models as bounded scenarios until independent review resolves the decision.

stop_conditions: Cash headroom fails the disclosed stress horizon
Existing W reward pool or U cap cannot honor accepted terms
No external Product or sponsor receipt can be evidenced for the proposed operating regime
Source or rights policy does not permit the measured Product flow
limitations: Literature establishes modeling methods, not this network's viability
No observed Product demand, costs, redemption behavior or cash receipts yet
No adopted W recycling or U successor contract
claim_ceiling: Candidate Research Inquiry only; mathematical feasibility conditions are not empirical viability or authority.
